reviews.comment: Professor Wright cares a lot for her students. She personally got to know me and did her best to help apply concepts from her class to my degree. She even went out of her way to give me out of classroom experience for my industry and connected me with some of her contacts. Overall, if you make an effort, she will do what she can to help you.

Codie cares a lot about the well-being of her students while simultaneously having high expectations. Sales minor classes require attendance and have a dress code, but you get used to it. It is worth it to complete, and lectures for 316 are based around emotional intelligence. Got me out of my comfort zone! Non-stressful class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: this one is for agec 216 but there's no tag. this 1 hour course required attendance but it was easy to complete with assignments being in-class, so don't skip class. dress code is business casual. there's a project to interview a business executive to complete anytime in the semester. if you're taking the sales minor, don't worry about this class!

One of the most discouraging professors I have ever had. She talks very highly of herself to the class on multiple occasions which did not match how she treated others. I do not understand her teaching methods at all considering she wrote a book over being building confidence but is highly condescending.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment:
**Agec 315**
Not the worst prof in the world but please do not take if you do not have to. I though I wanted to do the sales minor but after taking his 315 course it 100% discouraged me. She is NEVER to be found in office hours. Not flexible nor accessible. Hard grader and does not empathize. However, good to know for networking purposes.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She has many AGEC classes with Dr. Springfield which he is the one that makes all the rules for the class, but she does the lectures. She is very relatable, funny, beautiful, and makes class interesting. She makes the atmosphere very open and everyone feels comfortable to talk in class! She makes class interactive where we can talk with our peers.
